> 第3章 家规不可违（第1页）
陆沉甩了甩手掌，看也不看陆绍平，便拿下婉儿手中的剪刀，安慰道：“别怕，一条恶犬而已，我帮你教训他。”
婉儿娇躯颤抖，美眸尽是担忧之色。
陆绍平的修为可不差，炼体境五重。
而陆沉刚刚苏醒，虽然还有一些修为，但丹田和武脉均废，会是陆绍平的对手吗？
下一刻，一个歇斯底里的怒吼响了起来。
“陆沉，你这个废物也敢打老子，去死吧！”
陆绍平怒气冲冲，全身气息爆发，直接一拳向陆沉打了过来。
若在以前，陆绍平对陆沉那是恭恭敬敬的，哪里敢打婉儿的主意？
可今时不同往日了，陆沉已成废人，还被陆家驱逐，陆绍平欺负陆沉没有任何顾忌。即使打死陆沉，也有陆荣撑着，顶多挨长老们一顿骂，什么事也没有。
“一条狗也敢在我前面乱吠，真是不知死活。”
陆沉身影不动，出手如闪电，一下子抓住陆绍平打来的拳头，稍微用力一捏。
他的拳头被捏成一团血肉，废得不能再废了。
“你……你不是废了吗？怎么还有修为？”
陆绍平痛得眼泪鼻涕一起流，眼中尽是惊骇之色。
陆沉冷笑一声，一只手掌按在陆绍平的天灵盖上，吓得陆绍平魂飞魄散，连声求饶，“少……少主，我再也不敢了，你饶我一条狗命吧。”
“刚才，婉儿说你又来了，我很好奇，你昨天到现在，来了几次？来做什么？”
陆沉冷冷的看着陆绍平，眼眸杀意浮现，“你最好老实交待，否则你会死得很难看，别指望陆荣替你报仇，他是不会为一个死人出头的。”
“小人来了三次，是陆荣派来的，只要少主醒来，就赶少主出陆家。”

“可是，婉儿守在房外，一直不让小人进来。”
“小人该死，小人垂涎婉儿的美色，本想调戏，婉儿却以死相胁，小人才没得手。”
陆绍平为了活命，一五一十都说了出来。
“不是限我三天吗？陆荣这么急赶我出门，要是说没有阴谋，只有傻子才会信。”
陆沉看着陆绍平，嘴角有一道戏谑之色，“你觉得我像傻子吗？”
“是是是，的确是陆荣的阴谋，他怕夜长梦多，派我早点赶你出门，然后在外面将你诛杀，以绝后患。”
陆绍平见陆沉不好糊弄，只好如实招来，“少主饶命啊，小人也是身不由已的。”
陆沉脸色一沉，抓起陆绍平的另一只手，用力一捏。
“你滚回去，告诉你主子，我陆沉不走了，他等着承受我的怒火吧。”
陆沉一脚将陆绍平踢开，没兴趣杀一条狗，尤其是一条废狗。
他要把这条废狗扔回去，好好打一下陆荣的脸。
婉儿有些担忧，陆沉向来言出必行，说不走，就是不走。
可是，整个陆家已经放弃了陆沉，留得下来吗？
“我父亲虽然失踪，但他还是陆家家主，这里就是我的家，我就哪都不去！”
陆沉眸光闪动，嘴角冷笑，“陆家虽然残酷无情，但有一点做得不错，无论你是谁，只要你有足够的天资，就会培养你。”
“若我修为不在，那就没什么好说，死路一条。可我修为尚在，那班老家伙就会掂量三分，以他们的习性，多半向我身上压注，赌我在武道上仍有前途！”
“武道一途，本来就是一场冒险！”

>Chapter 3 House rules cannot be violated (Page 1)
Lu Chen waved his palms and without looking at Lu Shaoping, he took the scissors from Wan'er's hand and said comfortingly: "Don't be afraid, it's just a vicious dog. I'll help you teach him a lesson."
Wan'er's delicate body trembled, her beautiful eyes full of worry.
Lu Shaoping's cultivation level is not bad, he is at the fifth level of body refining realm.
And Lu Chen has just woken up. Although he still has some cultivation, his dantian and martial arts are both disabled. Will he be Lu Shaoping's opponent?
The next moment, a hysterical roar rang out.
"Lu Chen, you loser dares to hit me, so go to hell!"
Lu Shaoping was furious, his whole body burst with energy, and he punched Lu Chen directly.
If Lu Shaoping was respectful to Lu Chen in the past, how could he dare to have Wan'er's ideas?
But things are different now. Lu Chen has become a useless person and was expelled from the Lu family. Lu Shaoping bullies Lu Chen without any scruples. Even if Lu Chen was beaten to death, Lu Rong would still be there to support him. At most, he would be scolded by the elders and nothing would happen.
"A dog dares to bark in front of me. It's really reckless."
Lu Chen remained motionless and struck out like lightning. He immediately grabbed Lu Shaoping's fist and squeezed it a little harder.
His fist was crushed into a ball of flesh and blood, and was beyond useless.
"You... aren't you useless? How come you still have cultivation?"
Lu Shaoping's eyes were filled with horror as tears and snot flowed from the pain.
Lu Chen sneered and pressed a palm on Lu Shaoping's Tianling Cap. Lu Shaoping was frightened to death and begged for mercy, "Young... Young Master, I don't dare anymore. Please spare my life."
"Just now, Wan'er said you're here again. I'm curious, how many times have you been here since yesterday? What are you here for?"
Lu Chen looked at Lu Shaoping coldly, with murderous intent in his eyes, "You'd better tell the truth, otherwise you will die an ugly death. Don't expect Lu Rong to avenge you, he will not stand up for a dead man."
"The villain has been here three times. He was sent by Lu Rong. As soon as the young master wakes up, he will drive the young master out of the Lu family."
"But Wan'er is guarding outside the room and won't let the villain come in."
"The villain deserves to die. The villain covets Wan'er's beauty. He wanted to tease her, but Wan'er threatened her with death, so the villain failed."
Lu Shaoping told everything in order to survive.
"Isn't there a limit of three days for me? Lu Rong is so anxious to drive me out. If he says there is no conspiracy, only a fool will believe it."
Lu Chen looked at Lu Shaoping with a joking look on his lips, "Do you think I look like a fool?"
"Yes, yes, it is indeed Lu Rong's conspiracy. He was afraid of long nights and dreams, so he sent me to drive you out early, and then kill you outside to avoid future troubles."
Seeing that Lu Chen was not easy to fool, Lu Shaoping had no choice but to call him truthfully, "Young master, spare your life, I can't help myself."
Lu Chen's face darkened, he grabbed Lu Shaoping's other hand and squeezed it hard.
"Go back and tell your master that I, Lu Chen, will not leave. He will have to bear my wrath."
Lu Chen kicked Lu Shaoping away. He had no interest in killing a dog, especially a useless dog.
He wanted to throw this useless dog back and give Lu Rong a good slap in the face.
Wan'er was a little worried. Lu Chen always kept his word and said he wouldn't leave.
However, the entire Lu family has given up on Lu Chen, can he stay?
"Although my father is missing, he is still the head of the Lu family. This is my home, and I won't go anywhere!"
Lu Chen's eyes flashed and he sneered, "Although the Lu family is cruel and ruthless, there is one thing they do well. No matter who you are, as long as you have enough talent, they will train you."
"If my cultivation level is not there, then there is nothing to say and I will die. But if my cultivation level is still there, those old guys will consider it three points. Based on their habits, they will probably bet on me, betting that I still have a future in martial arts!"
"Martial artsA journey is always an adventure! "
